findings.message: If the reaper process is zombie itself, we should directly find upward until first living reaper process, right? Otherwise, the code in line 100-105 can be an endless loop.
findings.tp_fp_justification: find_reaper_process returns a subreaper even if it is a zombie; move_children_to_reaper_process then loops forever because move_process_children keeps failing on the same zombie reaper (StevenJiang1110: 'the code in line 100-105 can be an endless loop'). New logic in this PR.

source.alignment_reasoning: Defect range verified against the exam_head file contents; it differs from the comment's original anchor range, which is recorded in original_start_line/original_end_line.

findings.tp_fp_justification: In propagate_has_child_subreaper's BFS loop, `current_process.children()` is locked again instead of `process.children()`, so propagation never reaches grandchildren (StevenJiang1110: 'Should be process.children() instead of current_process.children() here?'). New function in this PR.
